name: MsoShadowType
description: Specifies the type of shadow displayed with a shape.The msoShadowType constants are numbered according to their order (left to right, top to bottom) within the Shadow Style set shown in the Drawing toolbar.

constants.name: msoShadowMixed
constants.description: Not supported

constants.name: msoShadow1
constants.description: First shadow type. Represents a solid outer shadow offset to the top-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow2
constants.description: Second shadow type. Represents a solid outer shadow offset to the top-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow3
constants.description: Third shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the upper-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow4
constants.description: Fourth shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the upper-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow5
constants.description: Fifth shadow type. Represents a solid outer shadow offset to the bottom-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow6
constants.description: Sixth shadow type. Represents a solid outer shadow offset to the bottom-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow7
constants.description: Seventh shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the lower-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow8
constants.description: Eighth shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the lower-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow9
constants.description: Ninth shadow type. Represents a solid compact outer shadow offset to the top-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow10
constants.description: Tenth shadow type. Represents an enlarged solid outer shadow offset to the top-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow11
constants.description: Eleventh shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the upper-left of the shape, identical to msoShadow3.

constants.name: msoShadow12
constants.description: Twelfth shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the upper-right of the shape, identical to msoShadow4.

constants.name: msoShadow13
constants.description: Thirteenth shadow type. Represents a solid layered outer shadow offset to the top-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow14
constants.description: Fourteenth shadow type. Represents a compact solid outer shadow offset to the bottom-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow15
constants.description: Fifteenth shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the lower-left of the shape, identical to msoShadow7.

constants.name: msoShadow16
constants.description: Sixteenth shadow type. Represents a solid perspective shadow at the lower-right of the shape, identical to msoShadow8.

constants.name: msoShadow17
constants.description: Seventeenth shadow type. Represents a compact solid dual-offset outer shadow offset to the bottom-right and top-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow18
constants.description: Eighteenth shadow type. Represents a compact solid dual-offset outer shadow offset to the top-left and bottom-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow19
constants.description: Nineteenth shadow type. Represents no shadow.

constants.name: msoShadow20
constants.description: Twentieth shadow type. Represents a solid outer shadow offset to the bottom of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow21
constants.description: Twenty-first shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the bottom-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow22
constants.description: Twenty-second shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the bottom of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow23
constants.description: Twenty-third shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the bottom-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow24
constants.description: Twenty-fourth shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow25
constants.description: Twenty-fifth shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the center of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow26
constants.description: Twenty-sixth shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow27
constants.description: Twenty-seventh shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the top-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow28
constants.description: Twenty-eighth shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the top of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow29
constants.description: Twenty-ninth shadow type. Represents a soft outer shadow offset to the top-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow30
constants.description: Thirtieth shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the top-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow31
constants.description: Thirty-first shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the top of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow32
constants.description: Thirty-second shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the top-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow33
constants.description: Thirty-third shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow34
constants.description: Thirty-fourth shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the center of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow35
constants.description: Thirty-fifth shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow36
constants.description: Thirty-sixth shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the bottom-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow37
constants.description: Thirty-seventh shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the bottom of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow38
constants.description: Thirty-eighth shadow type. Represents an inner shadow offset to the bottom-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow39
constants.description: Thirty-ninth shadow type. Represents a soft perspective shadow at the upper-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow40
constants.description: Fourtieth shadow type. Represents a soft perspective shadow at the upper-right of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow41
constants.description: Fourty-first shadow type. Represents a soft perspective shadow at the bottom of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow42
constants.description: Fourty-second shadow type. Represents a soft perspective shadow at the lower-left of the shape.

constants.name: msoShadow43
constants.description: Fourty-third shadow type. Represents a soft perspective shadow at the lower-right of the shape.
